sentences.en: The mosque was torched in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 那座清真寺在半夜被人放火烧了。

sentences.en: He had lit the torch before he entered the cave.
sentences.zh: 他在进入洞穴之前点燃了火把。

sentences.en: She shone her torch onto the floor before us.
sentences.zh: 她用手电筒照亮了我们面前的地板。

senses.zh: 火把，火炬；手电筒；启发之物 -
